DesignSystem.title: Design system: The record
DesignSystem.intro: For the team only; nothing links here. Every component as its board shows it, in both languages and both themes.
DesignSystem.pending: Built in a later Foundation task.

foundations.title: Foundations
foundations.intro: Color, type, space, the grid, icons, numbers, photographs, focus and motion. Everything after is built from these.

color.title: Color
color.intro: One ground, ink in two strengths, one rare accent. Status colors always come with a word and a glyph.

roles.surface: The only raised ground: the letter's margin, a featured row, side panels
roles.accentWash: A selected row or a chosen filter
roles.lineStrong: Edges that carry meaning: fields and checkboxes
roles.rule: The heavy line that opens a section or a record
roles.accent: The primary action, links, the current item and "what changed"

type.title: Type
type.intro: One family for both languages, Alexandria, in three weights. Arabic has its own larger, looser scale; English has its own. IBM Plex Mono is for Latin data only.
type.sampleAr: مجلسٌ هادئ مع رجلٍ رأى الكثير، فصار هادئاً.
type.sampleEn: Sitting across the table from someone who has seen a great deal, and is calm because of it.

spacing.title: Space
spacing.intro: Nine steps from 4 to 112. 112 between sections, 64 on phones.

grid.title: Grid
grid.labelColText: Every record starts with a fixed 120-wide column for its labels (situation, what I did, what changed, duration), with the value beside it. This column is what makes the pages read as one record.

icons.title: Icons
icons.note: One 1.5 line with square caps, at 20 or 24. An icon never sits in a circle or a colored square, and always comes with a word, except the familiar buttons (menu, close), which carry an aria-label. ↔ means it mirrors between Arabic and English.

numbers.title: Numbers
numbers.ltrNote: A link, an email or a phone number inside Arabic text reads LTR, in Western digits:

photography.title: Photographs
photography.portrait: Ahmed's portrait · comes from the dashboard
photography.missing: There's no photo for this project

alt.table: A wooden table with two chairs facing each other by a window
alt.notes: Hands writing in an open notebook
alt.window: Window light on a plain wall

photography.note: No corners, frame or shadow, and true colors. Under it a data line: who or where, and the crop. People are shown working, talking or listening, never as objects of pity. Photos of people here are placeholders, replaced by real ones before launch.

focus.title: Focus ring
focus.note: A solid 2px line with a 3px gap, in the focus color. Over 3:1 on every surface in both themes. Never hidden. Press Tab to see it.

motion.title: Motion
motion.note: One moment per page only: the page settles as it opens, in 600ms, with a fade and an 8px rise. Nothing moves on scroll, no numbers count up, nothing bounces or spins. With "reduce motion" the page appears still. This page's header settles that way.
